chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: The Charlie Kaley band collapses and Davison wins a fan contest to front it
summary: Kaley's Hollywood movie flops, so Meroff stages a two-week contest between Davison and Sid Pritikin to lead the second band, which Davison wins.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: (Beginning of Tape 2 - side one) -- Oriental ...to the Theater immediately - we had like 30 days - you know - to make everything jell--- and I remember at that time, we were just having a popularity contest between the Meroff band because what was happening was that Charlie Kaley was going to Hollywood with the other band leaders to make a picture and he made a picture called, "Lord Byron of Broadway"---
It was just such a tremendous failure----- --
And, he needed somebody to front the other band--

To front the other band - so it was between Sidney Pritikon and I -- and, for two weeks, we were featured -- first he on the guitar and me singing and playing the cornet and, then, they had the contest with votes -- the audience writing in and, uh, I won the damn thing hands down. I was way ahead and it meant that I would have been the leader which was very disappointing to me; I would have been the leader of the Charlie Kaley Band -- so, it would have been Wild Bill Davison's Band - no -- Bill Davison's Band at that time and, so,---
And, you would have made a lot of money too---
